WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (
  SELECT s.symbol_id, 0 AS depth
  FROM code.symbols s
  WHERE s.symbol_id = 'src/click/exceptions.py::ClickException'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT cb.class_symbol_id, d.depth + 1
  FROM descendants d
  JOIN code.class_bases cb ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id
  WHERE cb.class_symbol_id LIKE 'src/click/%'
)
SELECT symbol_id, depth AS inheritance_depth
FROM descendants
WHERE depth > 0
ORDER BY inheritance_depth, symbol_id
